body.name: \(\mathsf E_3\)
body.construction: Take \(T=3\), \(C=\{2,3,\infty\}\), \(p_g=1/3\), \(a_g=1\), \(b=(1,2,3)\), and treated multiplier \(3/2\), so the observed mean rows are \((1,3,9/2),(1,2,9/2),(1,2,3)\). Cohorts \(2\) and \(\infty\) have independent coordinate noise \(\pm1/10\). Cohort \(3\) has noise \(((U_0/10+e_1/20),(-U_0/10+e_2/20),(U_0/10+e_3/20))\), where \(U_0,e_1,e_2,e_3\) are independent Rademacher variables
inputs: four independent Rademacher signs in cohort \(3\)
independent coordinate signs in cohorts \(2\) and \(\infty\)
